Finding: Remote-access portal from a product family with a KEV-listed vulnerability (CVE-2024-3400)
Obligations: Essential Eight: patch operating systems (internet-facing network devices)
Treatment: Confirm PAN-OS version against vendor advisory and patch. Confirm patch timeframe for internet-facing devices.

Finding: Origin web server reachable directly bypassing the CDN
Treatment: Restrict origin to CDN address ranges or authenticated origin connection. Rotate origin IP.

Finding: DMARC policy set to monitor only (p=none) with SPF soft fail
Treatment: Align legitimate senders then move DMARC to quarantine and reject.

Finding: Staging login page exposed with an expired certificate
Treatment: Restrict access and add to asset inventory or decommission and remove DNS record.

Finding: Public code repository may reference internal hostnames
Treatment: Confirm ownership. Remove or make private. Check history for credentials and rotate.

Finding: Privacy policy does not disclose automated decision-making
Treatment: Identify ADM tools and update privacy policy before 10 Dec 2026.

Finding: Third-party scripts on quote page including offshore processing
Treatment: Confirm supplier due diligence records. Remove unused scripts. Confirm cross-border disclosure wording.

Finding: Mobile app privacy label not reflected in privacy policy
Treatment: Align privacy policy with app data collection. Confirm retention and access.
Confirm phishing-resistant MFA coverage and legacy authentication blocked.
